ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Business Companies Act, 2021 (Act No. 15 of 2021), Laws of Belize, as amended, read with the Companies Act, Chapter 250 of the Laws of Belize (residual provisions), the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Chapter 104 of the Laws of Belize (MLTPA), the Financial Services Commission Act, Chapter 262, the AML/CFT Guidelines issued by the Belize Financial Services Commission and the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit, and the FATF/CFATF Recommendations as implemented through statutory instruments.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory, evidence-based screening of all beneficial owners, directors, officers, authorized signatories and material counterparties against: (i) the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN); (iii) the U.K. OFSI consolidated list; (iv) the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit watchlists and adverse-media database; and (v) PEP and source-of-funds checks under the MLTPA customer due diligence, record-keeping, and suspicious transaction reporting obligations. Enhanced due diligence is triggered at or above 25% beneficial ownership, upon any nominee relationship, or upon any sanctions or adverse-media match, with mandatory STR filing to the Belize FIU.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR) IBC Name Reservation Module, filed exclusively through a licensed Belize registered agent via the BCCAR online filing portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the sole statutory language for registered legal entity names; the name must be expressed in Roman/Latin characters. The IBC Act 2021 permits recognized corporate suffixes including Limited, Ltd., Corporation, Corp., Incorporated, Inc., Sociedad Anonima, Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada, Societe Anonyme and comparable romanized equivalents. Non-Latin scripts (for example Chinese, Cyrillic or Arabic) are not registrable as the statutory name; such scripts may be used only as a non-statutory trade alias, and the romanized registered name controls in all registry filings, payment-rail KYC and downstream contracting.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: any token implying state patronage or a regulated financial activity without the prior written consent of the Registrar and the relevant licensing authority
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If BCCAR rejects the proposed name on grounds of identity, confusing similarity, prohibited token, or misleading suffix, the licensed registered agent must file a written reconsideration appeal with the Registrar of Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, annexing letters of no-objection, trademark registrations, or a materially distinguishing word. Registry reconsideration normally issues within 5-10 business days. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review by way of an originating summons before the Supreme Court of Belize within 30 days; commercially, the fastest remedy is an amended name re-submission preserving the desirable root word and restarting the 30-day reservation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a standard low-risk AI/LLM API platform: the Belize IBC must maintain a physical registered office and a licensed registered agent in Belize; a virtual-office structure is accepted where the licensed agent occupies the physical premises, accepts service of process, and retains the statutory registers, UBO records and accounting records. No local employees, physical plant, or board meetings in Belize are required for ISIC 6201 activity, and no economic-substance test applies to the tax-exempt non-resident IBC; the IBC Act 2021 only imposes maintenance of books and records accessible to the agent and disclosable to Belize authorities on lawful demand.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% per annum) for this Low_Risk_Standard classification absent sanctions matches, adverse media, CDD gaps, or regulatory complaint; the licensed agent may nevertheless trigger a virtual site visit or full EDD re-review upon material change in business model, payment-rail jurisdiction, or ownership profile.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 of the Laws of Belize (Revised Edition 2011), as amended by the International Business Companies (Amendment) Act, 2019; key sections: 5 (incorporation), 6 (memorandum and articles), 8 (certificate of incorporation), 15 (registered office and registered agent), 24 (directors), and 68 (tax exemption).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize City, Belize (Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form 1 (Application for Registration as an International Business Company) and Registered Agent's Declaration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; at least one share of no par value may be issued upon subscription, and no escrow or deposit of capital is required by the IBC Act. The company must maintain a registered office in Belize and appoint a licensed registered agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles are confirmed as the first shareholders, and the allotment of subscribed shares in the Register of Members is approved. (2) The registered office is established with the licensed registered agent in Belize City, Belize, and the registered agent is confirmed. (3) [Name] is appointed Director and [Name] is appointed Secretary, each with full authority to execute contracts, open and operate bank and merchant accounts (including Stripe and USDC), and manage the AI/LLM API business. (4) The Secretary is directed to file all statutory returns and maintain corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (through a registered agent licensed by the Belize Financial Services Commission)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a licensed Belize registered agent to conduct a name search at the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry to ensure the proposed company name is distinguishable and not prohibited. Submit the name reservation request in writing. Upon clearance, execute the registered agent engagement letter authorizing preparation of incorporation documents.
required_dossiers: Name search request form
List of up to three proposed company names
Certified passport copies of proposed subscribers
Registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or flagged, file an administrative objection through the registered agent or select an alternate name; the agent re-submits with a revised name certificate within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent and Subscribers (witnessed/notarized per agent KYC policy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in compliance with the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270. The subscriber subscribes to at least one share, appoints the first director(s) and secretary, and executes the document. All signatures must be notarially certified or witnessed in accordance with the agent's verification requirements, with concurrent KYC evidence.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as director and secretary
Certified passport copies of shareholders, directors, and officers
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the M&A for defective particulars, rectify via a supplementary declaration or amendment under section 17 of the IBC Act and re-execute the document before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing with the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize City (official filing counter / electronic submission channel)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the completed incorporation application (Form 1), executed Memorandum and Articles of Association in duplicate, and the Registered Agent's Declaration, together with the government filing fee of US$250. The Registrar reviews the application for formal compliance; upon acceptance, the application proceeds to certificate issuance.
required_dossiers: Completed incorporation application (Form 1)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (duplicate set)
Registered Agent's Declaration and consent
Government fee remittance receipt (US$250)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application receives a query notice, respond through the registered agent within the prescribed deadline with corrected forms; expedited re-processing is available upon payment of the applicable registry fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Establishment of Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry; Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company number. The registered agent prepares the corporate minute book, registers of members, directors and officers, share certificates, and common seal (if adopted). The statutory registered office is established at the registered agent's physical premises in Belize City, Belize.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Registered Agent's confirmation of registered office address
Register of members and register of directors and officers
Share certificates and corporate seal (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains clerical errors, apply to the Registrar for a corrected certificate under the IBC Act; if incorrectly refused, seek judicial review in the High Court of Belize.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and Corporate Records; Bank and Payment Provider Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; Corporate Secretariat; Financial Institutions and Payment Processors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organizational meeting of directors and adopt the First Board Resolution confirming share subscription, registered office, officer appointments, and banking/PSP authority. Authorize the secretary to maintain statutory records and open operational accounts. Use the Certificate of Incorporation, certificate of incumbency, and certificate of good standing to onboard payment rails (Stripe and cryptocurrency USDC custody).
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution (minutes of organizational meeting)
Certificate of incumbency
Certificate of good standing
Corporate KYC package for bank and payment processor onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or payment provider rejects the documentation, provide notarized or apostilled certified copies, a fresh incumbency certificate, and updated director/secretary identification; alternatively, apply to the Registry for a current certificate of good standing or select another licensed institution.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial or manufacturing licence is required under the International Business Companies regime for offshore digital AI/LLM API services conducted from outside Belize; the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry remains the sole registry interface.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — an IBC engaged exclusively in foreign-sourced digital services does not require a Belize operating permit. If the company later establishes physical premises in Belize, a General Retail (Trade) License and building occupancy permit would become necessary.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Government of Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no physical installation, discharge, or emission activity in Belize; the generative AI/LLM API platform has zero physical footprint, therefore no EIA registration or full assessment is triggered under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations (2003) and Environmental Protection Act, Cap. 328.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable at formation stage; if future server hosting or office premises are established in Belize, compliance with the Belize Effluent Limitations Regulations, Air Quality (Emissions) Regulations, and solid and hazardous waste handling rules would be required for wastewater, VOCs, and e-waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for remote, digital-only service delivery. If a physical office is later opened in Belize, the company must obtain fire safety certification from the Belize National Fire Service, structural load inspection and occupancy clearance from the local building authority, and workplace registration under the Labour Act.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service (BTS), Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize; primary portal: https://www.belizetaxservice.gov.bz (web login for corporate income tax and GST returns); the Belize Companies Registry, within the Office of the Attorney General, issues the IBC company registration number and certificate of incorporation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned IBC first obtains its statutory company number from the Belize Companies Registry via an approved local registered agent. For tax identity, the agent files Form IRS 01 (Application for Tax Identification Number / TIN) with the Belize Tax Service, together with: (i) certificate of incorporation, (ii) articles/memorandum of association, (iii) registered office address in Belize, (iv) notarized passport copy and proof of residential address of the ultimate beneficial owner, and (v) power of attorney appointing the local agent. BTS issues a 9-digit TIN. Because the IBC is tax-exempt, BTS will normally issue a TIN in a non-filer status. If the company intends to make any commercial purchases subject to GST, file a Form GST 02 application to obtain a GST registration number; for pure exporting AI/LLM API service providers, GST registration is available but not mandatory unless domestic taxable supplies exceed the threshold.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — Belize International Business Companies are non-resident entities exempt from income tax, business tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, and GST on all offshore business income under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270), s. 3(1). AI/LLM API platform revenue from foreign customers is not Belize-source income; the entity does not become tax-resident in Belize so long as central management and control is exercised outside Belize and no domestic commercial licence is obtained.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Belize operates a territorial, unitary tax regime without a US-style check-the-box entity classification election. The only meaningful elections are: (1) conversion of an IBC to a domestic Belize company under s. 142 of the IBC Act, effectively rendering it taxable at the standard 12.5% enterprise tax and 12.5% GST on domestic supplies; (2) a special election under s. 11 of the IBC Act licensing the company to transact business domestically with a Belize resident, which exposes only that specific domestic activity to Belize corporate tax and GST; and (3) for IBCs formed before 2002, an election to remain under the original exemptions. Belize has not implemented OECD hybrid mismatch rules; no hybrid entity election or CFC look-through election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Sales Tax (GST) — Belize's VAT-equivalent regime under the General Sales Tax Act, Cap. 52:01
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 75,000 (approximately USD 37,500) annual value of taxable supplies delivered in Belize. Exported AI/LLM API services and all B2B services to non-residents are zero-rated and therefore do not count toward the registration threshold. A Belize IBC exporting 100% of its services may nevertheless register voluntarily for GST to recover input tax on local administrative expenses, but such registration is not compulsory for a pure offshore service exporter
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal e-invoicing or continuous transaction control (CTC) regime is currently implemented in Belize. The Belize Tax Service mandates electronic filing of GST returns and electronic payment through the BTS online portal; paper invoices may be issued but must be sequentially numbered and contain the GST registration number when the business is GST-registered. No digital stamping, cryptographic QR code, or government clearance API applies to export invoices. For exports of physical goods, the Customs and Excise Department uses the ASYCUDA World electronic single-window system for the Customs Export Declaration; for pure digital AI/LLM services, parties file only the BTS electronic Annex ECS (Export of Services) summary, without customs clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for AI/LLM API inference and token-provider services under s. 32(1)(a) of the GST Act where: (i) the customer is a non-resident of Belize; (ii) the contractual place of supply is wholly outside Belize; (iii) the API service is delivered via offshore cloud infrastructure and the output is not used, consumed, or stored for the benefit of a person in Belize; and (iv) the billing address, customer TIN/VAT identification, and merchant settlement evidence demonstrate the cross-border nature of the transaction. The IBC must preserve the customer contract (or electronic terms of service), the API usage records, token settlement statements, and a certificate of offshore use signed by the customer. Where the service is underpinned by data centres in Belize or is rendered to a Belizean resident even partially, zero-rating is denied in respect of that portion.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration — for goods, a C&D-6 electronic declaration filed in ASYCUDA World; for digital AI/LLM API services, a 'Service Export Declaration' annex submitted via the BTS electronic portal or a bank-certified export proceeds statement if full GST-registered

Commercial Invoice / Final Export Invoice — must show the IBC name, TIN, customer overseas address and foreign VAT/TIN, the zero-rated annotation 'GST 0% Export of Services' or 'Export of Goods', and encrypted payment/API usage details

Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (for goods) — or, for digital services, the delivery certificate: the API access log, the bandwidth/usage report, and the customer's written confirmation of receipt outside Belize

Inward Remittance Certificate — a Central Bank of Belize export repatriation form or bank transfer receipt (SWIFT MT103 in USD), or a merchant settlement statement from Stripe/USDC exchange showing net USD proceeds credited to the IBC's account, evidencing foreign exchange inflow
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Belize Tax Service retains audit power over any zero-rated export claim. For fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating, s. 54 of the GST Act imposes a penalty equal to 200% of the tax understated, plus interest at 1.5% per month, and criminal liability under s. 55 (fine up to BZD 25,000 and imprisonment for up to three years). If the zero-rating claim is dishonestly used to bring Belize-source income into the IBC exemption, the Income and Business Tax Act deems the revenue to be taxable domestic income, resulting in a 12.5% enterprise tax clawback for six years from the assessment date, and revocation of IBC tax-exempt status for subsequent years. Additionally, under anti-money laundering rules, failure to repatriate or properly document proceeds within 180 days may trigger reporting to the Central Bank of Belize and the Financial Intelligence Unit, with civil penalties of up to BZD 50,000 and director disqualification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar is pegged to the US dollar at BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00 under the Currency and Banks Act. Current-account convertibility for resident Belizean entities is available for approved purposes subject to exchange-control licensing, while capital-account transactions require CBB permission. An International Business Company (IBC) is expressly excluded from the Exchange Control Act, meaning it is treated as a non-resident entity for FX purposes and may receive, hold, and remit any freely convertible currency without CBB approval. Profit repatriation by an IBC is unhindered by Belize law: no withholding taxes apply to dividends, interest, or royalty payments, provided the IBC maintains its statutory records and corporate registry filings in Belize. The only practical hurdle is bank-level compliance, which requires the beneficial ownership disclosure and source-of-funds documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For ordinary resident Belize exporters, the Exchange Control Act requires export proceeds to be remitted to Belize within 90 days of shipment and ultimately surrendered to the banking system. Under the Central Bank's Foreign Exchange Administration Practice, 50% of repatriated export earnings must be sold to an authorised dealer (commercial bank) for Belize dollars at the official pegged rate, while the remaining 50% can be held in a foreign-currency account. An IBC registered under the International Business Companies Act is exempt from all surrender and conversion requirements; it may retain 100% of foreign-currency receipts in offshore or domestic foreign-currency accounts. Therefore, for the AI/LLM API platform structured as a Belize IBC, there is no statutory surrender timeline or mandatory conversion ratio applicable.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency USD/EUR) with Capital Escrow Account option for statutory share capital

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-to-Low for mainstream fintech EMIs, High conditional for specialised cross-border EMIs willing to serve Belize IBCs after enhanced due diligence. Legal constraints: mainstream EU/UK EMIs (Wise, Revolut, Payoneer, etc.) generally decline Belize IBC applications because the IBC lacks a physical branch or substantive presence in the EMI's jurisdiction, and the Belize registry is considered high-risk by some European AML supervisory bodies. Specialised B2B EMIs (e.g., Currenxie, Neat, Mercuryo) may approve a Belize IBC if the UBO has a clean profile and the company provides audited financial statements, a licensed Belize registered agent, and a comprehensive business plan evidencing real AI API operations. USDC-based rails are generally not acceptable to EMIs; USDC clearing requires an independent OTC/VASP (e.g., Coinbase Commerce, Circle) to convert to fiat before settlement via standard bank wires.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Belize Banks' Non-Bank Financial Institutions policy under the Central Bank of Belize mandates in-person verification for the ultimate beneficial owner and at least one director of an IBC. Remote opening is permitted only when the bank's compliance committee approves a notarised digital KYC package after a scheduled video conference, supported by an introducer letter from a regulated Belize registered agent. In practice, the majority of tier-1 domestic banks require the UBO to appear physically in Belize City or at a designated correspondent office, or to be present before a Belize notary public/consulate. An IBC may also appoint a nominated Belize director to represent the company, but the UBO identity must still be verified.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership concealment via bearer share or nominee arrangements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A copy of the Belize IBC's registered agent certificate, updated register of members and beneficial ownership register, dated and signed corporate filings under the International Business Companies Act, UBO passports and proof of residential address, a signed declaration that no bearer shares exist, and a legal opinion from Belize Counsel confirming the chain of control.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital-asset or cryptocurrency nexus (USDC target payment rail)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A written AML/CFT compliance manual for the platform, contractual agreements with licenced VASP/Crypto intermediaries, blockchain forensic reports for all USDC transactions, evidence of conversion from USDC to fiat through regulated exchanges, and a declaration signed by the UBO that no proceeds derive from virtual-asset money laundering.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume inbound flows from international customers/Stripe without invoiceable detail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The platform's customer KYC profile archive, a template of its invoice and billing records for LLM API usage, a consent order or tariff sheet, bank statements for the corresponding settlement account, and a third-party audit report confirming that the transactions correspond to actual AI API subscription and usage fees.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: IBC brass-plate concern (lack of economic substance)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copies of the registered office lease, the registered agent's confirmation of corporate meetings, statutory records maintained in Belize or by an authorised custodian, bank evidence that the IBC holds its own accounts and has not stripped all profits, and board minutes detailing the AI infrastructure decision-making processes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wires for capital injection should be sent via SWIFT MT103, using the purpose code 'GDDS' (equity capital) or 'R004' (investment contribution) depending on the correspondent bank's acceptance. The beneficiary line must state the IBC's full name and account number at the Belize bank; the remittance reference must read 'SHARE CAPITAL INJECTION — REPORT FILED WITH BELIZE IBC REGISTRY'. The IBC should issue a board resolution authorising the issuance of shares, a subscription agreement, share certificates, and a funds-receipt ledger. For USDC-based capital injection, USDC is first liquidated into USD at a licensed OTC desk or exchange (e.g., Coinbase) under a documented treasury policy, then wired to the Belize bank; banks will require proof of the OTC trade ticket and wallet-address ownership. Verification: the Belize bank will typically request a Certificate of Good Standing, a list of directors and shareholders, and an undertaking from the registered agent confirming that the beneficial owner has funded the account from a bank in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade and operating disbursements from the IBC should be executed through SWIFT MT103 wires from its Belize bank account to counterparty accounts. For cloud/AI compute purchases (e.g., AWS, OpenAI, GPU vendors), the IBC should use the beneficiary's invoice reference and the SWIFT purpose code helps classify the payment as service import. A commercial letter of credit (LC) is appropriate for substantive hardware procurement; the IBC can instruct a Belize issuing bank to open a documentary credit under ICC UCP 600 through a North American or European correspondent. For USDC supplier payouts, the IBC may disburse USDC directly from its treasury ledger if the counterparty maintains a compatible wallet, subject to an internal IP address verification and wallet-allowlisting process; alternatively, use a payment-rail aggregator that combines fiat and stablecoin settlement into a single invoice line.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/BZD forwards booked with a Belize commercial bank under the official currency board parity (only available to IBCs where the counterparty is not subject to the Exchange Control Act)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on BZD with an offshore counterparty for hedging USD/BZD exposure without physical settlement
Cross-currency swaps for EUR/USD and GBP/USD aligned with the IBC's functional reporting currency, executed outside Belize with an internationally regulated bank
Currency options covering AI API service fees payable in cryptocurrencies (e.g., USDC/USD, ETH/USD) through a licensed institutional custodian

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual License Fee Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (Registrar of International Business Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 August each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% on unpaid fee; continued non-payment triggers administrative strike-off notice and eventual dissolution after 6 months of default.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit threshold for Belize IBCs; audit is required only if mandated by a shareholder resolution or specific future regulatory obligation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory framework imposed; financial records may be kept under IFRS, US GAAP, or another recognized internal standard at the company's discretion.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Belize IBC law requires current beneficial ownership information to be maintained with the registered agent; any shareholding transfer or change in UBO must be updated in the company's statutory records contemporaneously, with no separate annual UBO filing to the Registry under the standard IBC regime.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable; voluntary review or audit USD 1,500 - 3,500 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Business Company (IBC) under the Belize International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270. The headline rate for ordinary Belize-resident companies is 25% under the Income and Business Tax Act, but an IBC that does no business in Belize and holds no Belize-situs assets is wholly outside the tax net.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective tax rate. The IBC exemption is permanent under the Act with no sunset; the only recurring government cost is the annual license fee (USD 100 to USD 1,000 by authorized capital band) plus the registered agent's compliance fee. Dividends, capital gains, royalties, and interest received by the IBC are also exempt. Loss carryforward provisions are irrelevant because the IBC has no taxable income; the domestic Income Tax Act's 5-year carryforward rule is moot for the exempt entity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return under the annual return and license fee provisions of the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270; filed electronically through the International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) / Registrar of International Business Companies e-filing portal, typically submitted by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. Filing due within 3 months after each incorporation anniversary.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The filing window opens on the incorporation anniversary and closes 3 months after that anniversary; the annual government license fee must accompany the return. A 10% late surcharge applies thereafter, and continued default can lead to automatic strike-off after approximately 12 months.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation and the unique IFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the mandated corporate suffix such as Limited or its approved abbreviation; the name must contain no element suggesting connection with Belize residents or prohibited business with Belize.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical Belize address of the registered office and identification of the licensed registered agent maintaining the office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be a physical address in Belize maintained by a licensed agent; a post office box alone is insufficient. Non-resident shareholders must confirm the agent holds KYC and beneficial ownership records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classes of shares, aggregate authorized capital, number of issued shares, and consideration paid or deemed paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard IBC capital bands determine the annual fee tier; bearer shares must be immobilized and surrendered to the registered agent and are treated as high-risk for AML compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, addresses, nationalities, and dates of appointment of directors and registered shareholders, together with ultimate beneficial ownership declarations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident persons may hold 100% of the IBC with no Belize economic ownership; nominee shareholders and nominee directors are permissible, but the beneficial owner must be disclosed to the registered agent under the AML/KYC regime.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IBC is non-resident, conducted no business in Belize with Belize residents, owns no Belize real property, and summary financial data comprising assets, liabilities, and gross turnover required under the 2018 amendment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where gross turnover exceeds the prescribed threshold, the IBC must attach a certified balance sheet; the AI/LLM API revenue must be reported in USD with BZD conversion so the Registrar can risk-assess substance expectations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment attracts a 10% surcharge on the annual government license fee; the Registrar may impose additional penalties, suspend the company's filing status, and strike the IBC off the register after sustained default, typically around 12 months. Restoration requires settlement of all arrears, surcharges, restoration fees, and any court-sanctioned conditions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return under the International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations, 2019; filed with the IFSC through the dedicated ESR electronic portal or by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. Filing due within 6 months after the end of the IBC's financial year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The ESR return must be filed no later than 6 months after financial year-end. Every IBC carrying on a 'relevant activity' must file. An IBC that claims tax residence in another jurisdiction must file the non-Belize resident form and submit a valid foreign tax residence certificate; otherwise the onerous IP substance test applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the applicable ESR activity: for a GenAI and LLM inference API platform, the relevant categories are 'Intellectual Property Business' (if income is derived from exploitation of proprietary model weights and API inventions) or 'Distribution and Service Centre Business' (if the platform resells third-party API capacity).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident IBCs must not select 'Excluded Entity' or 'Tax Resident Outside Belize' unless a valid foreign tax residence certificate is held and current; incorrect selection triggers automatic high-risk IP scrutiny and information exchange.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Core Income-Generating Activities Performed in Belize
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Detailed narrative of the CIGAs conducted in Belize, including contract negotiation, API pricing decisions, IP exploitation strategy, customer onboarding, invoicing, and model-licensing approvals.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee-managed IBCs with all decisions made in the shareholder's home country will fail the substance test; the return must identify specific employee names, board minutes, meeting locations, and documentary evidence of Belize-based decision-making.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Leased or owned physical premises in Belize, number of full-time qualified employees engaged in the relevant activity, and the amount of operating expenditure incurred in Belize during the period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide lease agreements, payroll records, and bank statements evidencing onshore spend; the expenditure, staff, and premises must be proportionate to the turnover generated by the AI/LLM API business and cannot be token or artificial.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue earned from AI API tokens, inference usage fees, subscription receipts, and licensing proceeds, together with disclosure of any outsourcing arrangements with foreign group companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Outsourcing core functions, such as model development, infrastructure hosting, or contract execution, to a foreign developer violates the IP substance rules; the return must state precisely which functions are retained in Belize and why outsourcing is justified.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the ESR return or to satisfy the economic substance test exposes the IBC to monetary penalties, typically in the range of USD 10,000 to USD 25,000 per year of default, compulsory strike-off, and automatic reporting of the IBC and its beneficial owner to the Belize Competent Authority under the exchange-of-information framework. False declarations attract criminal fines and imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Belize imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions made by an IBC to non-resident shareholders. Dividends, distributions of capital, and liquidation proceeds are entirely exempt under the International Business Companies Act. No administrative waiver or advance ruling is required; the exemption is statutory and automatic.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No DTA relief is necessary because the domestic withholding rate is already nil. Where a shareholder must substantiate the zero-withholding position in its home jurisdiction, the IBC should produce: (1) a Certificate of Good Standing issued by the IFSC; (2) an exemption and status letter from the registered agent confirming the IBC is non-resident and tax-exempt; and (3) agent-certified or audited financial statements. Belize does not issue a tax residency certificate for an IBC because the entity is statutorily non-resident; invoking the limited Belize DTA network, including the CARICOM double taxation agreement and the bilateral UK arrangement, is unnecessary and would undermine the exemption by suggesting Belize tax residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% on outbound royalties and debt interest paid by an IBC under the statutory IBC exemption. By comparison, a non-exempt ordinary Belize company is subject to domestic withholding of 15% on outbound royalties, technical fees, and management charges, with applicable rates on interest paid to non-residents; treaty reductions would be required in that parallel regime, but the IBC's exemption supersedes all domestic charging provisions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable. Belize has no codified transfer-pricing documentation threshold (Local File / Master File) for IBCs because the IBC has a zero domestic taxable base and is excluded from the Income and Business Tax Act. In practice, under the 2019 Economic Substance Regulations, an AI/LLM API platform generating IP-related revenue above approximately USD 1,000,000 (BZD 2,000,000) per year is treated as a high-risk IP company and must evidence economically substantive onshore functions; the IFSC compares local payroll, premises, and expenditure against this revenue to test substance.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations, 2019 apply to every IBC carrying on a relevant activity. A Generative-AI and LLM inference API-token platform that licenses model weights, inference endpoints, and metered API usage is characterized as an 'Intellectual Property Business' (high-risk) if income derives from IP exploitation, or as a 'Distribution and Service Centre Business' if it resells third-party API capacity. Either classification requires filing the Economic Substance Return within 6 months of financial year-end, performing core income-generating activities in Belize, maintaining adequate physical premises and qualified full-time employees, and keeping all core decision-making onshore. The pure equity holding exemption does not cover IP or distribution businesses. An IBC may be excluded only where it is tax-resident in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction and can prove that residence with a current foreign tax residence certificate.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Sham Company Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Belize IBC as a shell to hold AI/LLM API revenue and proprietary IP while de facto management, contract negotiation, daily operations, and bank control remain with the shareholder in the shareholder's home country; failing to disclose the IBC and its income to the home tax authority; interposing nominee directors to conceal effective control; artificially circumventing CFC and controlled-foreign-company or economic-substance rules in the owner's jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the IBC Act, an IBC that carries on business with Belize residents or owns Belize real property is liable to fines and strike-off; knowingly making false declarations to the IFSC exposes the company to fines of up to BZD 25,000 and imprisonment of officers up to 2 years. In the shareholder's home jurisdiction, the structure is recharacterized as a sham and the full AI API income is assessed to tax with penalties and interest; international exchange-of-information requests will be honoured by Belize under applicable TIEAs and the Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, including nominee directors, face piercing of the corporate veil: personal tax assessments on the repatriated income, civil restitution orders, asset freezes, travel bans, disqualification, and imprisonment where fraud or evasion is proved. Foreign prosecutors may invoke mutual legal assistance and extradition channels against directors who signed false declarations or concealed beneficial ownership.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a nil or excluded-entity ESR return without a valid foreign tax residence certificate; holding all board meetings and IP-management decisions offshore; outsourcing the core AI/LLM licensing and API infrastructure functions to foreign affiliates; maintaining no physical premises, no staff, and no local operating expenditure proportionate to the API income of the IBC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under the ESR Regulations include monetary sanctions, typically USD 10,000 to USD 25,000 per year of continued default, mandatory remedial directions from the Registrar, and ultimately compulsory strike-off and dissolution of the IBC. The IBC and its beneficial owner become reportable information under Belize's exchange-of-information framework and are automatically transmitted to the tax administration of the ultimate beneficial owner, destroying the confidentiality layer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false substance declarations are personally liable under the false-statement provisions of the IBC Act to fines of up to BZD 25,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years; the registered agent may resign and the directors are exposed to civil actions by counterparties and to personal sanction in the parent group's jurisdiction for knowingly maintaining an artificial structure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Shell Company Abuse in Crypto Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IBC's USDC and cryptocurrency payment rails together with nominee shareholders to launder proceeds, obscure token-sale revenues, or process payments for unlicensed or sanction-circumventing AI services; failing to maintain accounting records and beneficial ownership information; refusing to respond to AML/KYC requests from the registered agent, correspondent banks, or crypto exchanges; operating the IBC as a pure wallet shell with no commercial substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering under the Belize Money Laundering Act, Cap. 104 as amended is punishable on indictment by fines up to BZD 500,000 and imprisonment up to 14 years; summary conviction carries significant fines and imprisonment. Crypto assets and bank accounts linked to the IBC can be frozen and forfeited, and the Registrar may strike off the company for failing to preserve accounting records for the statutory minimum retention period.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are individually indictable for AML offences; travel bans, asset forfeiture, and extradition under bilateral and multilateral mutual assistance treaties are available; nominee directors who permit unknown principals to control the IBC face criminal liability for failing to identify and verify beneficial owners and for permitting the shell to operate without an effective compliance officer.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Annual Fee Default and Statutory Strike-Off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to pay the annual government license fee or file the annual return within the 3-month anniversary window; keeping the IBC dormant without paying the minimum annual fee; allowing the registered agent to resign and failing to appoint a successor within the statutory period; transacting through a struck-off IBC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late payment triggers a 10% surcharge on the unpaid license fee; continued non-payment for approximately 12 months results in administrative strike-off and dissolution. Upon dissolution, all assets of the IBC, including GenAI model IP, API contracts, and platform receivables, vest in the Government of Belize or an appointed official, and contracts transacted thereafter by directors are void. Restoration requires payment of all arrears, surcharges, restoration fees, and, in contested cases, a court order.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue trading after strike-off become personally liable for all debts of the dissolved IBC; counterparties may petition the court to restore merely to sue the directors; the registered agent's resignation places directors under immediate personal responsibility for a non-compliant structure, and restoration proceedings may impose personal costs and penalties against the directors.
